resources.string: Immediately halts the printer (firmware E-stop). You will need to restart Klipper to print again.
This stops the current job. The printer will not finish this print.
Compress — move nozzle closer to bed
Expand — move nozzle farther from bed
Babystep step size, %1$s millimeters — tap to change
Set the selected spool active; long-press to unload
Immediately halts the printer (firmware E-stop). You will need to restart Klipper to print again.
No spools match. Clear filters to see your inventory.
Spoolman subtracts the spool weight from your weighed total to get filament remaining.
The printer host will reboot. The connection will drop while it restarts.
The printer host will power off and the connection will drop. You\'ll need to power it back on physically.
Moonraker will restart. The connection will drop briefly and reconnect on its own.
Restarts Klipper firmware on ALL connected boards, not just this one. The printer will be unavailable for a few seconds while it reconnects.
Klipper will soft-restart on all boards and the printer will be briefly unavailable. Any active print will be lost.
No printable gcode files. Add files in Moonraker, then reopen Files.
Metadata is unavailable. The print can still start.
Removes this file from Moonraker. This cannot be undone.
Spool check found something to review:
Printer responses appear here. Run a command or macro and the reply shows up live.
History unavailable. Check the printer connection — live responses will still appear.
Pick the macros you use most in Manage, and they\'ll launch from here.
This printer reports no gcode macros. Add gcode_macro entries in your config to use this screen.
Underscore-prefixed helper macros are hidden. Show hidden to reveal them.
Bookmarked macros show on the home screen for quick access. Pin the ones you use most.
Disable steppers? This will un-home all axes.
Move the print head and bed.
Precisely measures the distance between your probe and the nozzle tip. Tap to nudge the nozzle to paper-drag height, then accept.
Maps the height variation across the print bed. Runs automatically — no interaction during calibration.
Calculates how much to turn each bed-leveling screw. The display shows turns and direction.
Adjusts multiple Z-axis motors for a level gantry. Runs automatically, may iterate.
Levels a CoreXY printer\'s four-point gantry. Runs automatically, may iterate.
Save calibration and restart Klipper? All pending changes will be applied.
Remove this profile? This cannot be undone.
Name must use letters, numbers, underscores, dots, and hyphens only.
Activate a bed mesh, or load a saved profile.
Run to probe the bed screws
Run to level the gantry automatically.
Probing and adjusting. Hands-off — wait for it to converge.
Show the floating Style/Size theme cyclers over every screen for live theme tweaking. Turn off to hide them and restore your theme.
A jib is a triangular headsail set on the bow that improves airflow over the mast sails and adds driving power, especially when sailing upwind.
A jiib is a lightweight frontend set on Android that improves Klipper interactivity over alternatives and adds functionality, especially on older devices.
Screen stays on while jiib is open
Optimized — tap to let jiib stay connected with the screen off
wss/https — requires a TLS reverse proxy in front of Moonraker
Plain ws/http on the local network
This will remove the connection profile. The printer itself is unaffected.
Tap Add to set up your first printer.
API key (leave blank to keep saved key)
No printers found — enter the host manually.
This clears your custom pool colors and randomize back to the default.
Pick a hue on the ring, then adjust saturation and brightness below
Tap to customize — shape carries the meaning, so color is yours
Tap to customize (applies in Colorful; this mode shows the fixed safety palette)
Color is a redundant cue — shape carries the safety meaning. Pick any color.
Saved for Colorful mode. This mode (%1$s) renders status from its fixed safety palette, so the picked color won\'t show here.
A theme is built from a seed color, a color style, and a set of pool colors.
Dark and light flip primary surfaces to their contrast; generated colors shift to stay legible.
Full color shows maximum color indicators throughout the app. High Contrast focuses on only the major theme color and intent colors. Simple is theme color only.
Pick a hue. The accent and pool are generated from it; lightness is set automatically for contrast.
Tap a swatch to set its color. Randomize re-rolls the pool from the seed.
TLS certificate not trusted — check the Moonraker reverse-proxy certificate
Tap a setting to see what it does and change it.
Sets the app-wide text size. Affects every screen.
Keep the screen on while jiib is open, so the printer display never sleeps.
Show the webcam tile when a printer has a camera. Turn off if this device won\'t use the webcam or can\'t handle the stream.
Offer a Z-babystep adjust over the first layers of a print to dial in nozzle height.
Leave blank to skip or 0 to turn off
Select a preset to view its setpoints
No presets yet — tap Add to create one
Select a control to edit its increment steps.
Only needed if your install requires it
.local names can be unreliable — prefer the numeric IP
Connection timeout — printer off or not on this network
Unauthorized — add this device\'s IP to Moonraker trusted_clients, or enter an API key
Tap Scan to search your network
